name: Nee Shiyoo! VS Tsuyokiss
original_name: 姉しよっ！VS つよきす
source:
[url=/c216]Hiiragi Serori[/url] has to investigate Ryuumeikan as part of a request by a mysterious client. Obviously, this intrusion doesn't sit well with the rule-abiding [url=/c59]Kurogane Otome[/url].
Nee Shiyoo! VS Tsuyokiss is a crossover between Tsuyokiss and Nee, Chanto Shiyou yo!, first released in Tech Gian, where the characters from both series go on a rampage in Matsukasa!
translation:
[url=/c216]Hiiragi Serori[/url] 必须根据神秘客户的请求调查龙名馆。显然，这种入侵行为与遵守规则的 [url=/c59]Kurogane Otome[/url] 格格不入。
尼希佑！VS Tsuyokiss是Tsuyokiss和Nee, Chanto Shiyou yo! 的联动作品，首次在Tech Gian中发布，两个系列的角色在Matsukasa! 中横冲直撞！
